Sam (product): Quick sync — we need to finalize the scope for tenant controls on the API surface for the next milestone. Several customers asked for project-scoped keys + rotation + per-surface scopes (chat/embeddings/rerank) and function/tool calling restrictions. Need a decision by EOD Fri. Initial thoughts?

Anya (eng): We can support org-scoped and project-scoped API keys. Project keys map to project_id and scopes, which is straightforward from a data model perspective. Downsides: per-request auth check adds ~0.5-1ms before batching; gateway caching helps. Suggest default to org keys for existing customers and opt-in project keys.

Liam (security): Rotation is critical. Recommend: short-lived ephemeral tokens for hosted with a rotate endpoint, and allow long-lived tokens for Dedicated/Private. Must include audit logs + key hashing. For rotation UX: support rolling rotations (create new key, phase out old for X days). Need KMS/HSM integration for Private.

Maria (infra): We can cache token->project mappings at the edge to mitigate auth latency. Need DB migration for token table (fields: key_id, project_id, scopes[], created_by, status, rotation_meta). Backwards compat: accept existing keys for 60d after launch and emit deprecation warnings in logs.

Sam (product): Draft launch criteria (proposed):
- API: create/list/delete API keys at org and project level
- Rotation: POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate + staged deprecation window
- Scopes: token-scoped enforcement for chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tools
- Console: key management UI (create, rotate, revoke)
- SDKs/docs updated with examples and migration guide
- Observability: audit logs, rotation events, and alerting for failed rotations
- Rollout: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with perf/regression checks
- Perf target: p99 latency impact <= 2% for typical workloads

Anya (eng): Implementation note: enforcement should be in the gateway so it applies across hosted/dedicated/private control planes (where applicable). Sample header and rotate example for docs: 
```
# create key (response contains key value once)
POST /v1/keys 
Authorization: Bearer $ORG_API_KEY
{ 
  "project_id": "proj_123",
  "scopes": ["completions","embeddings"],
  "expires_in": 3600
}

# rotate
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/abcd1234/rotate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ORG_API_KEY"

# usage
Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>
```

Liam (security): Audit/logging details: record event_type (create/rotate/revoke), actor_id, key_id (store only hashed id in logs), old_key_fingerprint, new_key_fingerprint (hashed), ip, user-agent. Also, emit metric for rotate_failures. Add automated alert if rotate_failures > 5 in 1h for a tenant.

Sam (product): Scope negotiation: to keep scope small for first launch, propose we DO NOT implement fine-grained per-function ACLs (e.g., allow call to specific external tool) yet — that's complicated and impacts tool routing. Focus on project-level scoping + allowed surfaces (chat/embeddings/rerank/tools) and rotation. We'll treat per-function ACLs as follow-up (post-MVP).

Anya (eng): Agree. Enforcement of 'allowed_surfaces' as token metadata is low friction: gateway checks a small set membership before forwarding. We'll need to add schema validation in key create API. Effort estimate: ~2 backend engineer-weeks + 1 infra week for caching and migration.

Maria (infra): Rollout tasks I see: DB migration, gate flag in gateway, edge cache invalidation strategy, canary config, console feature flags, and migration job to populate existing keys with default scopes. Estimate: 3 sprints total to safe launch if we sequence correctly.

Sam (product): Owner assignments: Anya -> API + gateway enforcement (owner). Liam -> security + audit + alerts (owner). Maria -> infra + rollout + migration. Docs -> Sam (I'll draft migration guide + SDK snippets). I'll open RFC and PRs after we agree.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: RFC created: https://r.rw/rfc/532 ("tenant-controls: project keys, rotation, scopes") — initial draft posted, please review.

Sam (product): OK let's lock this: org + project keys, rotation endpoint, token-scoped surfaces, no per-function ACL in MVP. Action items: Anya will draft API spec (by Wed), Maria will draft migration/rollout plan (by Thu), Liam will produce audit/alert spec (by Thu). I'll sync with sales to surface to customers. :thumbsup: 

Anya (eng): I'll throw up a proto PR for the gateway check and sample DB migration tonight.

Liam (security): I'll stub audit entries and add rotate_failure alert to the oncall runbook.

Maria (infra): Will start infra tickets and schedule migration window.

Sam (product): Great — thanks team. We'll reconvene after initial RFC feedback.
